set(SOURCE_FILES ${QT_RES}
    main.cpp
    model/Data.cpp
    model/Definitions.h
    controller/MainController.cpp
    controller/Worker.cpp
    view/MainWindow.cpp
    view/AppStyle.h
    view/ColorDefinitions.h
    view/SizeDefinitions.h
    view/control/Controlbar.cpp
    view/sidebar/CollapsibleElement.cpp
    view/sidebar/NumberInput.h
    view/sidebar/PopupMessage.cpp
    view/sidebar/SideBar.cpp
    view/sidebar/SimulationList.cpp
    view/simulation/FloatingBar.cpp
    view/simulation/SimulationView.cpp
    view/status/StatusBar.cpp)

# Platform app icons, generated by packaging/generate-icons.sh
set(APP_RES ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/res/app)
if(APPLE)
  list(APPEND SOURCE_FILES ${APP_RES}/RealTimeFluid.icns)
  set_source_files_properties(${APP_RES}/RealTimeFluid.icns
      PROPERTIES MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION Resources)
elseif(WIN32)
  list(APPEND SOURCE_FILES ${APP_RES}/RealTimeFluid.rc)
endif()

add_executable(RealTimeFluid WIN32 MACOSX_BUNDLE ${SOURCE_FILES})

# macOS: Qt frameworks are bundled into RealTimeFluid.app/Contents/Frameworks
set_target_properties(RealTimeFluid PROPERTIES
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_PLIST ${APP_RES}/Info.plist.in
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE RealTimeFluid.icns
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_NAME "Real-Time Fluid"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER "de.rwth.sdi.RealTimeFluid"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
    MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING ${PROJECT_VERSION})
if(APPLE)
  set_target_properties(RealTimeFluid PROPERTIES
      BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON
      INSTALL_RPATH "@executable_path/../Frameworks")
endif()

target_compile_definitions(RealTimeFluid PRIVATE PROJECT_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}")
target_include_directories(RealTimeFluid PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

target_link_libraries(RealTimeFluid PRIVATE
    fluid_solver
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Widgets
    Qt6::Svg)

install(TARGETS RealTimeFluid
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
    BUNDLE DESTINATION .)
